I hope the technical team takes these issues seriously and provides a reliable, glitch-free platform soon.

review.title: Request to Add Key Options Trading Features
review.body:
I regularly use the HDFC Security app for trading, and while it’s feature-rich for equities and F&O, I noticed some critical functionalities advertised on your site aren’t accessible in the app’s interface. This impacts usability significantly.

Specifically, I’d like to request inclusion or improved visibility for:
	1.	Bracket Orders for Options – (entry + stop-loss + target) to match web capabilities.
	2.	Advanced Option Chain with Strategy Builder – full Greeks and one-click trades.
	3.	Multi-leg Order Entry – to efficiently trade spreads, straddles, strangles.
	4.	GTT Orders for Options – for positional trades to avoid manual SL re-entry.
	5.	Cover Orders for Options – reduce margin via entry plus stop-loss.
	6.	Trailing Stop-Loss in Options – auto-adjust SL during intraday moves.
	7.	Order Modification Speed – ability to adjust SL/TP without canceling.
	8.	Margin Preview & Breakup for Options – live view before order placement.
	9.	Currency Trading Access – Although the app advertises support for currency segment, I cannot find or trade in currency futures/options within the app. Please enable consistent access to currency derivatives on mobile.

Enhancing these features would greatly improve user experience and ensure parity with the web platform. Looking forward to your improvements.

Thank you for your attention.
